format.replay: for each case build one paywall with `config`, then run the steps in order against a facilitator stub that serves each step's `facilitator[i].response` to the paywall's i-th facilitator request and asserts the request equals `facilitator[i].request`
format.request: a request step hands the paywall `request` (method, url, headers, clientIp for the per-IP cap) and `route` (amount in centavos, optional description, mimeType, resource)
format.outcome: {type: response, response} when the paywall answered by itself; {type: paid, chargeId, amount, handler, response?} when the request was paid: the handler output `handler` is handed to finalize and `response` is what the paywall returns; handler `throws` means the handler raised (release, no settle) and `hold` means finalize runs in a later `finalize` step
format.facilitatorRequests: method, url, headers and the exact JSON body text; header names are lowercase; the Idempotency-Key on /settle is a random UUID written as "<uuid>" and must be the same on every attempt of one settle
format.facilitatorResponses: {status, headers?, body} is served as JSON with content-type application/json; {network: true} is a transport error
format.responses: status, every header (lowercase names) and the exact body text; header values that are base64 headers compare byte for byte
format.clock: the paywall's clock is fixed at `config.clock` for every step

cases.description: no PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: the paywall asks the facilitator for a charge and answers 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED
route description and mimeType go into resource; the description is sent to /pix/charges
behind a proxy, publicOrigin replaces the request origin in the resource URL (query kept)
HEAD never creates, verifies or settles a charge
charge creation is capped per client IP; the refused request gets 429 with Retry-After and no facilitator call
IPv6 clients share a bucket per /64 prefix
an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address counts as the IPv4 address
a 429 from /pix/charges is passed on with its Retry-After
the facilitator cannot be reached: 502 facilitator_error
the facilitator refuses the merchant token: 500 unauthorized
a charge whose amount differs from the route price is never offered: 502
an unreadable PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: 400 invalid_header
a PaymentPayload that is not a p-x402 Pix payload: 400 invalid_payload
verify, run the handler, settle; the reply carries PAYMENT-RESPONSE without payer data
the requirements sent to the facilitator take amount and resourceUrl from the route and the request, not from the client
verify says settlement_pending: 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED (error settlement_pending), PAYMENT-RESPONSE and Retry-After: 2, the same charge
verify refuses with charge_expired: 402 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE
the handler answers 500: the response passes through and the charge is not settled
any handler status >= 400 skips settle, not only 5xx
the handler throws: no settle, the lock is released, and the same signature is verified again
while one request for a charge is between verify and settle, another gets settlement_pending without verify
a transport error and a 5xx on /settle are retried with the same Idempotency-Key
three failed /settle attempts: 502 facilitator_error, the handler output is discarded
settle refuses with charge_already_consumed: 402 with PAYMENT-RESPONSE, the handler output is discarded
the facilitator refuses the merchant token on /verify: 500 unauthorized
